Class ConstantTables

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.linker.ConstantTables
public final class ConstantTables extends Object
Read-only lookup tables kept in flash (.rodata) instead of the 8 KiB arena: a static final one-dimensional primitive array whose <clinit> initializer is all compile-time constants (static final short[] T = {1, 2, 3};) and which every reachable method only ever reads as T[i] or T.length.

Flash cannot be written by an ordinary store, so the read-only rule is checked on the bytecode, never assumed: each getstatic of a candidate is followed through straight-line code until the value is consumed, and it must be consumed as the array operand of an array load or arraylength. A table passed to a method, stored in a local or field, written to, or used across a branch keeps the old behaviour (allocated in the arena by its <clinit>), and ramFallbacks says why, so a program that compiled before still compiles unchanged.
